## Selected systems
- rust-stark-zkvm: https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/rust-stark-zkvm
  STARK zkVM in Rust with custom ISA, Winterfell proofs, HTTP/MCP proving and CI proof gates.
- Decentralized.Host: https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/Decentralized-
  Sovereign self-hosted infrastructure with signed intent, local admission, explicit state, Raft, WireGuard, chaos and conformance testing.
- decentralized.hosting: https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/decentralized.hosting
  Self-hosted deployment mesh using FastAPI, Docker nodes, load-aware scheduling, Traefik and MCP.
- XFree: https://www.xfree.in
  Browser developer, SEO and AI tooling built with React, TypeScript and Vite.
